items.title: Someday
items.content_html:
Purpose of the Page #

Projects, tools, and technologies I want to explore someday. This is my queue of things to check out, organized by category. Each item has a checkbox for tracking progress - once explored, I’ll add a summary or link to a longer post.

Self-Hosted Services #

  • Karakeep (2025-07-19) Read-later and bookmarking service to replace texting links to myself. Want to explore the app and extension, set up RSS feeds for lists.

    • I am running Karakeep, would like to hook it into my blog like thoughts but just haven’t taken the time to do it

  • Rybbit (2025-08-23) Self-hosted Google Analytics alternative. Forked the repo, want to try on quadtask.

  • Domain Locker (2025-12-09) Domain monitoring service. Stood it up and want to see how it fits into the lab over the next year.

Platform & DevOps #

  • Komodo (2025-08-23) Platform-as-a-product tool that aligns with my vision for “platform as a product”. Discovered it matches much of what I envisioned.

  • IronCalc (2025-11-07) Self-hosted spreadsheet solution. Need to manage the build, starting to think about a reusable Forgejo action for Docker builds.

    • Unfortunately there’s not much to write about - neat project but I don’t need it

  • LLDAP (2025-11-10) Lightweight LDAP for homelab SSO. Want to get SSO setup at home for repoflow, considering LLDAP and Authelia for authentication.

  • Repoflow (2025-08-09) Artifactory replacement for artifact storage. Requested a free license and experimenting with it for homelab platform storage.

    • Note: Have blog posts but no dedicated project/glossary page yet

Storage Solutions #

  • Garage (2026-02-15) Distributed object storage. MinIO is archived, so looking at Garage as a replacement for object storage.

  • RustFS (2026-02-15) MinIO alternative in Rust. Alternative to MinIO being considered alongside Garage.

Mobile & Apps #

  • Conduit (2025-08-23) Open-WebUI Android app. Found it but needs to build and sideload the APK.

Desktop & Window Management #

  • AeroSpace (2025-11-26) Tiling window manager for Mac. Want to try it out for window management.

    • I am using AeroSpace on my Mac - it’s beautiful

  • Fluid Tile (2025-11-26) Tiling window manager option. Saw it as a tiling window manager option to try after getting tiling working on Mac with AeroSpace.

Productivity & Utilities #

  • ChoresRewards (2025-08-10) Chore tracking with rewards for kids. Looking for a way to track and reward chores for both myself and the kids; considering rewriting it in FastAPI if the auth mechanisms don’t work out.

  • Lazyjournal (2025-11-15) TUI for host logs. Lazydocker/git-inspired tool for viewing host logs that I learned about.

  • Oh My Opencode (2025-12-31) Compare with OpenAgents. Need to compare OpenAgents with oh-my-opencode.

  • Handy (2026-02-03) STT tool for voice control. Started using for speech-to-text on work Mac to talk to neovim and opencode; excited to explore vocally conversing with agents.

Already Explored (Have Pages) #

These projects already have glossary entries or blog posts:

  • Affine - Self-hosted Notion-like platform (see Affine)
  • Apprise - Centralized notification service (see apprise)
  • Forgejo - Self-hosted Git forge (see forgejo)
